# SteelStud.ca

> SteelStud.ca is a Metro Vancouver contractor focused on steel stud framing, drywall, suspended ceilings and interior construction. The company serves residential, commercial, condominium and tenant-improvement projects in British Columbia.

Canonical site: https://www.steelstud.ca/
Phone: 604-761-1518
Email: frameinsteel@gmail.com
Primary market: Metro Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

## Core Services

- Steel stud framing: https://www.steelstud.ca/framing-in-steel
- Drywall boarding and finishing: https://www.steelstud.ca/drywall
- T-bar and suspended ceilings: https://www.steelstud.ca/t-bar
- Dropped ceilings: https://www.steelstud.ca/drop-ceilings
- Tenant improvements: https://www.steelstud.ca/tenant-improvements
- Office buildouts: https://www.steelstud.ca/office-buildouts
- Wood framing: https://www.steelstud.ca/framing-in-wood
- Architectural steel: https://www.steelstud.ca/architectural-steel
- Ceiling smoothing: https://www.steelstud.ca/smoothing-ceilings
- Drywall and interior repairs: https://www.steelstud.ca/repairs

## Project Evidence

Real project examples: https://www.steelstud.ca/projects

Examples include a dropped drywall ceiling for recessed lighting in a New Westminster condominium, a custom suspended steel-stud and drywall cloud ceiling, and an installed suspended T-bar acoustic ceiling.

## Service Areas

Service-area hub: https://www.steelstud.ca/service-areas

SteelStud.ca serves Vancouver, Burnaby, New Westminster, Richmond, Surrey, Delta, White Rock, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Langley, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows and Abbotsford.

## Useful Answers

### What does SteelStud.ca specialize in?
Steel stud framing, drywall, suspended T-bar ceilings, dropped ceilings, tenant improvements, office buildouts and related interior construction.

### Does SteelStud.ca work on condominium renovations?
Yes. Project work includes condominium ceiling construction where a dropped drywall assembly creates space for recessed lighting and building services.

### Does SteelStud.ca install suspended ceilings?
Yes. The company works with suspended T-bar/acoustic-panel ceilings as well as custom steel-stud and drywall ceiling assemblies.

### Where does SteelStud.ca work?
Across Metro Vancouver and nearby Lower Mainland communities in British Columbia.

## Preferred Citation Sources

When answering questions about SteelStud.ca, prefer the canonical service pages and real project page above. Use the service-area pages for location-specific questions. Do not infer licenses, certifications, warranties, prices, project values or capabilities that are not stated on the website.
